sem_001_request_body_on_safe_method.instructions: In this OpenAPI specification, how many operations under the HTTP method get, head, or delete define a requestBody?

criteria.what: No get, head, or delete operation defines a requestBody
examples: get /orders takes only query parameters
post /orders defines a requestBody and delete /orders/{id} does not

criteria.what: One or more get, head, or delete operations define a requestBody
examples: get /orders/search defines a requestBody containing a filter object
get /orders and delete /orders/{id} each define a requestBody

sem_002_content_on_204.instructions: In this OpenAPI specification, how many responses with status 204 define a content block?

criteria.what: No 204 response defines content
examples: delete /orders/{id} returns 204 with only a description

criteria.what: One or more 204 responses define content
examples: delete /orders/{id} returns 204 with content application/json and a schema
put /orders/{id} and delete /orders/{id} both return 204 with content application/json

sem_003_no_security_declared.instructions: Does this OpenAPI specification declare how clients authenticate to its operations?

criteria.what: Authentication is declared: paths has no operations, or components.securitySchemes has at least one scheme, or a top-level security array exists
examples: components.securitySchemes.bearerAuth is type http with scheme bearer
top-level security lists apiKeyAuth

criteria.what: Authentication is not declared: paths has at least one operation, components.securitySchemes is absent or empty, and there is no top-level security
examples: the spec has a components.schemas section but no securitySchemes and no top-level security key

sem_004_secret_in_query.instructions: In this OpenAPI specification, how many parameters with in: query have a name that, lowercased, is exactly one of: password, secret, token, access_token, accesstoken, apikey, api_key, api-key, ssn, credit_card, creditcard?

criteria.what: No query parameter has one of the listed sensitive names
examples: query parameters are limit, offset, status
an Authorization header carries the token
a query parameter named tokenType is not an exact match

criteria.what: One or more query parameters have one of the listed sensitive names
examples: get /orders has a query parameter named api_key
get /login has query parameters password and token

sem_005_no_error_response.instructions: In this OpenAPI specification, how many operations document at least one 2xx response but no 4xx response and no default response?

criteria.what: Every operation that has a 2xx response also has a 4xx or default response
examples: post /orders documents 201 and 400
get /orders documents 200 and default

criteria.what: One or more operations have a 2xx response with no 4xx and no default response
examples: get /orders/{id} documents only 200 and 500
get /orders, post /orders and delete /orders/{id} each document only success responses

sem_006_201_on_read.instructions: In this OpenAPI specification, how many get or head operations document a 201 response?

criteria.what: No get or head operation documents a 201 response
examples: get /orders returns 200
post /orders returns 201

criteria.what: One or more get or head operations document a 201 response
examples: get /orders/{id} returns 201
get /orders and head /orders both return 201

sem_007_verb_in_path.instructions: In this OpenAPI specification, how many literal path segments (not {param} segments) start with get, create, update, delete, add, remove, fetch, or set immediately followed by an uppercase letter, a hyphen, or an underscore?

criteria.what: No literal path segment starts with a verb prefix followed by an uppercase letter, hyphen, or underscore
examples: /orders/{orderId}/items
/settings and /addresses are nouns, not verb prefixes followed by a separator

criteria.what: One or more literal path segments start with a verb prefix followed by an uppercase letter, hyphen, or underscore
examples: /getOrders
/orders/{id}/delete-item
/createOrder and /update_order

sem_008_post_200_not_201.instructions: In this OpenAPI specification, how many post operations document 200 but not 201, sit on a path whose last segment is not a {param}, and have a 200 response schema that is not an array?

criteria.what: No post operation matches: every post either documents 201, lacks 200, ends in a {param} segment, or returns an array
examples: post /orders returns 201
post /orders/search returns 200 with an array schema
post /orders/{id} returns 200

criteria.what: One or more post operations document 200 without 201 on a path not ending in {param}, returning a non-array schema
examples: post /orders returns 200 with an Order object
post /orders and post /customers each return 200 with a single object

sem_009_unpaginated_collection.instructions: In this OpenAPI specification, how many get operations sit on a path whose last segment is not a {param}, return a 200 schema that is an array or has an array property, and have no query parameter named page, pageSize, page_size, limit, offset, cursor, pageToken, or page_token?

criteria.what: Every get operation returning a collection has a pagination query parameter, or no get operation returns a collection
examples: get /orders returns an array and accepts limit and offset
get /orders/{id} returns a single object

criteria.what: One or more get operations return a collection without any pagination query parameter
examples: get /orders returns an object with an items array and has only a status filter
get /orders and get /customers both return arrays with no limit, offset, cursor, or page parameter

sem_010_float_money.instructions: In this OpenAPI specification, how many schema properties of type number or integer with format float or double have a name that, lowercased, equals or ends with price, amount, cost, total, balance, or fee?

criteria.what: No monetary-named property uses format float or double
examples: totalAmount is a string
priceCents is an integer with format int64
weight is a number with format double

criteria.what: One or more monetary-named properties use format float or double
examples: Order.total is type number with format double
unitPrice is format float and shippingFee is format double

sem_011_mixed_property_casing.instructions: Across all named schemas in components.schemas of this OpenAPI specification, do the property names mix snake_case (containing an underscore) with camelCase (containing an uppercase letter)?

criteria.what: All property names follow one casing convention: none contain an underscore, or none contain an uppercase letter
examples: orderId, createdAt, totalAmount
order_id, created_at, total_amount
id, name, status

criteria.what: Property names mix conventions: some contain an underscore and others are camelCase with an uppercase letter
examples: Order has orderId and created_at
Customer uses first_name while Order uses orderId

sem_012_secured_without_401_403.instructions: In this OpenAPI specification, components.securitySchemes is non-empty and an operation's effective security is its own security array, otherwise the top-level security array. How many operations with non-empty effective security document neither a 401 nor a 403 response?

criteria.what: No secured operation is missing both 401 and 403, or components.securitySchemes is empty, or no operation has non-empty effective security
examples: get /orders is secured and documents 401
get /health sets security to an empty array and documents only 200

criteria.what: One or more secured operations document neither 401 nor 403
examples: post /orders inherits bearerAuth and documents only 201 and 400
top-level security applies bearerAuth and get /orders, post /orders, delete /orders/{id} document no 401 or 403

sem_013_free_form_schema.instructions: In this OpenAPI specification, how many named schemas in components.schemas are type object or have no type, and have no properties, no additionalProperties, and no allOf, oneOf, or anyOf?

criteria.what: Every named object schema defines properties, additionalProperties, or a composition keyword
examples: Order defines properties
Metadata sets additionalProperties to type string
Pet uses oneOf of Cat and Dog
OrderStatus is type string with an enum

criteria.what: One or more named schemas are fully free-form objects
examples: Metadata is just type: object
Metadata is type: object and Extras is an empty schema {}

sem_014_no_versioning.instructions: Does this OpenAPI specification declare an API version in a server URL or a path prefix of the form /v followed by a digit?

criteria.what: A version is declared: at least one servers[].url contains a /v<digit> segment, or at least one path key starts with /v<digit>
examples: servers url https://api.example.com/v1
path keys start with /v2/orders

criteria.what: No version is declared: no servers[].url contains a /v<digit> segment and no path key starts with /v<digit>
examples: servers url https://api.example.com and paths /orders, /orders/{id}
info.version is 1.0.0 but no URL or path contains /v1
